videos.caption:
Coconut Rough Protein Balls 🥥🍫

[high protein, low carb, high fibre, probiotics,  low fat, sugar free, nutritious]

These simple and delicious protein balls are wholesome and nutritious. They are very filling and make the perfect snack to satisfy sweet cravings when you need a low-calorie, high-protein snack 🙌🙌

Ingredients (makes 9 balls )
- 60g blended oats @uncletobys 
- 60g vegan vanilla protein @macromike ( I used vanilla buttercream almond protein) my d/c: MM-JADER-10 or casein 
- 30g shredded coconut + extra for sprinkling 
- 30g coconut flour 
- ~ 3 tbsp granulated sweetener (I use natvia) 
- 1/4 cup water
- 1/2 cup (100g) vanilla yogurt @yoproau
- lemon zest 

White chocolate 
- 60g white chocolate ( I used low carb protein white choc “coconut rough bar ) @vitawerx
- 1/2 tsp coconut oil 

Method
1. In a bowl, add all your dry ingredients, then the wet ingredients, and mix until combined. If the mixture is too dry, add more water; if it is too wet, add more oats or coconut flour.
2. Let the mixture rest until thickened for few minutes. The texture should not be sticky and should be easy to roll. 
3. Roll onto 9 balls 
4. Melt chocolate at 30 sec intervals in microwave until melted 
5. Coat balls in chocolate and sprinkle some shredded coconut 
6. Transfer to fridge or freezer for chocolate to set. Enjoy ! 🫶

Macros ea 40g ball 
120 calories 
8g protein 
6g fat 
8g carbs

I can't stop making these APPLE CINNAMON PROTEIN PANCAKES 🍎🥞

38g protein, gluten free, and the batter is made right in the blender 😍

For this recipe I used @promix Madagascar Vanilla protein powder!🍦 It’s made with clean, all natural ingredients and is PERFECT to use for baking high protein treats, protein oatmeal, making smoothies and more!

You can use the discount code ✨CLAIRE✨ for 10% off Promix!

Recipe below or comment 'Recipe' and I'll send you a printable version of the recipe! 

Pancakes:
- ½ cup rolled oats
- 1 serving @promix Vanilla Whey Protein 
- ¼ cup unsweetened applesauce
- 1 large egg
- ¼ cup milk
- ½ teaspoon cinnamon
- ½ teaspoon baking powder
- ½ teaspoon vanilla extract
- Pinch of salt

Maple Cinnamon Apples:
- ½ medium apple (I love honey crisp)
- ½ tablespoon maple syrup
-¼ teaspoon cinnamon
- ½ teaspoon butter
- Splash of water if needed

Instructions
- Add the rolled oats to a blender and blend until they form a fine flour.
- Add the vanilla whey protein, applesauce, egg, milk, cinnamon, baking powder, vanilla extract, and salt. Blend until smooth.
- Let the batter sit for 2–3 minutes to thicken. 
- Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small skillet over medium heat. Add the diced apple, maple syrup, and cinnamon. Add a small splash of water if the pan looks dry.
- Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the apples are tender and coated in the maple cinnamon sauce.
- Heat a separate, lightly greased skillet over medium-low heat. Divide the batter into 3–4 pancakes, cooking in batches if needed.
- Cook for 2–3 minutes, until the edges are set and bubbles begin to form. Carefully flip and cook for another 1–2 minutes, or until cooked through.
- Stack the pancakes and spoon the warm maple cinnamon apples over the top. 

Enjoy!

These Honey Garlic BBQ Chicken Quesadillas are crispy on the outside, loaded with juicy seasoned chicken, and stuffed with white cheddar + sharp cheddar for the ultimate cheese pull.

Makes 4 large quesadillas
Ingredients:
• 3 large chicken breasts, about 10 oz each

• 1 cup shredded white cheddar
• 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar

• 1 tsp onion powder
• 1 tsp paprika
• ½ onion, sliced or diced
• Cooking spray or a little oil for the skillet

Directions:

2. Add the chicken to a skillet over medium-high heat and cook, stirring occasionally.
3. About halfway through cooking, add the onion and continue cooking until the chicken reaches 165°F and the onions are softened.
4. Divide the chicken and onions between 4 tortillas and add about ½ cup cheese to each.
5. Fold and cook in a lightly sprayed skillet for 2–3 minutes per side until golden, crispy, and melty.

SALT & PEPPER CHICKEN & CHIPS

If you like this you will love my cookbook 👀 link in bio. 

Per serving (makes 4):
405 kcal

10 g fat

Ingredients:

500 g chicken breast, cubed
700 g potatoes, cut into fries
1 egg, beaten
4 tbsp cornflour
1 onion, sliced
1 green pepper, sliced
1 red pepper, sliced
2–3 garlic cloves, chopped
1 red chilli, sliced
2 spring onions, chopped
1 tbsp oil + 1 tsp oil
Oil spray
Salt & pepper seasoning:

1 tsp salt
1 tsp black or white pepper
½ tsp Chinese five spice
½ tsp garlic powder
¼–½ tsp chilli flakes

Potato spice 
1tsp garlic powder 
Salt & pepper 

Method:

Soak the fries in cold water for 15–30 mins, then dry well.

Toss the fries in 1 tbsp oil and salt, then air fry at 200°C for 18–20 mins, shaking halfway.

Coat the chicken in egg, then toss in cornflour mixed with half the seasoning.

Spray with oil and air fry at 200°C for 12–15 mins, flipping halfway.

Fry the onion, peppers, garlic and chilli in 1 tsp oil for 2–3 mins.

Toss everything together with the rest of the seasoning and top with spring onions.

Located atop a small hill in Kerala, this 12000 sq. ft. courtyard home could not look more typically traditional; from the outside.

Step through the door, however and the interior is an elegant mix of global influences and reclaimed pieces selected to work in harmony with the traditional architecture
.
Redesigned by Temple Town this property has been turned into a sanctuary holding fast to the core principles of promoting local and sustainable interiors
. 
Our client wanted her home to have a sense of calm and to be a place she could wind down in when she returns from her travels. At the same time she wanted a sociable space, where she could welcome guests in a relaxed atmosphere. A minimalist scheme that would look modern, fresh and feel relaxing.

This home combines functionality with clean lines whilst also having a sanctuary like feel.
The courtyard connects all the main action zones, the living, dining, foyer and bedrooms, giving definition to the space whilst retaining those open views
.
Embrace natural: For the living room we chose only a few key shades picked from the surroundings
.
The palette used is delicate greys, beiges, browns and greens to lighten the space and not detract from the natural beauty
.
In the dining room the marble table top adds a tactile element to a pared back scheme and a simple customized iron pendant light complements the natural look
.
A collection of mismatched white porcelain crockery with violet and white flowers of “Daisy Chrysanthemum” creates a simultaneously understated and dramatic interior
.
In each bedroom the neutral palette of wooden flooring and white walls is offset with charming accessories
.
We used a restrained palette of materials and colors, glass and crisp white to create visual unity throughout the home.
 
We are all about encouraging reuse, so we help people to recognize what fabulous items they already own and yet create interiors that work well functionally and is always tranquil and welcoming.

One of the unique seats of the America GS 964.  With the shell made by Recaro, the upholstery is the work of Porsche AG with the assistance of 3M.  Covered in one-off aniline leathers created especially for the America GS, the leathers in these special seats are (1) a green primary leather with multiple other colors applied by silkscreen and (2) a purple for the racing harness eyelets.  Handcrafted, the craftsmanship of these lightweight RS buckets is superb.  But in addition to being seats engineered for safety in motorsport, these seats are both subtle and stunning.  Finally, with the attention to detail in these chairs, when you get out and drive, on road and on track, you will drive tastefully as they are beautiful.
 
Finally, 3M’s role in these seats.  When the America GS was being built, the glues used in German automobiles were not, particularly in warm climates, the strongest or the most durable.  As a result, there was concern that, particularly the leather on the seatbacks, might come loose, peel or fall off.  To prevent this, after a bit of persuasion on my part and without charge, 3M in America sent a 50 gallon drum of a special glue to Porsche in Germany.  And, after more than 30 years, there have been no issues.
